name: trade
description: One executed or settled trade: a buy (tranche) or a sell, in the paper (mock) account or the real account. The decision behind it is a separate decision record.

source_key.description: Import key (source file + position, e.g. paper:<code>:tranche1:buy). The same key is the same record: re-running the import never adds it twice.

account.description: paper: the mock-trading account; real: the user's real holdings.

traded_at.description: Trade date (fill date; for funds the settlement date of the order).

requested_at.description: Order date when it differs (fund orders settle days later).

tranche.description: Tranche number of a split purchase (1회차 = 1).

price.description: Fill price per share, or the fund NAV used.

planned_amount.description: Planned amount before the fill, KRW.

cost.description: Sell: what the sold units had cost, KRW.

return_pct.description: Sell: realized return in percent (negative = loss).

sell_ratio.description: Sell: share of the holding sold (0-1).

reason.description: Why it was sold, as written in the source.

condition.description: Execution condition of the tranche, as written.

source_status.description: Status text as written in the source.

note.description: Source note on the trade, as written.

relations.note: A trade and the decision behind it may describe the same event. Count buys and sells from trade; ask 'why' from decision.
